rules.title: mineDres-Team community rules
rules.intro: We are here for CS2 tactics, demo reviews and sane conversation. The rules are short — breaking any of them leads to a warning, a timeout or a ban.
rules.respect.title: Respect
rules.respect.text: No insults, harassment, threats, discrimination of any kind or hateful content. Argue about lineups, not about people.
rules.spam.title: No spam
rules.spam.text: No flooding, no @everyone abuse, no cross-posting the same message, no unsolicited direct messages.
rules.nsfw.title: No NSFW or shock content
rules.nsfw.text: Pornography, gore, violence, malicious links and files are banned everywhere, avatars and nicknames included.
rules.ads.title: No advertising or scams
rules.ads.text: Cheats, boosting, account trading, gambling, NFTs, third-party servers and any scam schemes mean an instant ban.
rules.language.title: Channel languages
rules.language.text: Pick your language in the panel above and post in your channels: 🇷🇺 русский · 🇺🇦 українська · 🇬🇧 english. In shared channels use the channel language.
rules.privacy.title: Privacy
rules.privacy.text: Never post personal data, yours or anyone else's: addresses, phone numbers, documents, private chat screenshots without consent.
rules.identity.title: Nickname and avatar
rules.identity.text: Keep a readable, typeable nickname and avoid offensive, political or advertising avatars and statuses.
rules.moderation.title: Moderation
rules.moderation.text: Moderation decisions are not debated in public channels — open a ticket or message the administration. Ban evasion is permanent.
rules.discord.title: Discord rules
rules.discord.text: The [Discord Terms](https://discord.com/terms) and [Community Guidelines](https://discord.com/guidelines) apply. You must meet the minimum age in your country.
rules.footer: By staying on the server you accept these rules · mineDres-Team
